flow-definition.description: Scheduled Nexus disk reclamation. The docker-hosted repo has the docker-hosted-retain cleanup policy attached (see scripts/nexus-init.sh); this job drives the built-in tasks that enforce it on demand so disk is reclaimed promptly after big pipeline runs instead of only on Nexus's own schedule. Runs "Cleanup service" (applies retention policies -> soft-delete) then "Cleanup unused docker blobs" (reclaims blob disk). Nexus analog of docker-housekeeping (which reclaims the agent host).
